source.quote: Among this, KRW 34,998.1 billion was recognized as expenditures, excluding government subsidies and capitalized expenses. ... R&D costs (expenses) 34,998,142 28,339,724 24,919,198 [KRW million, 2024, 2023, 2022]

notes: Values in KRW billions (KRW 6,450,044 million and 34,998,142 million). Taxes from the consolidated cash flow statement (the report also prints a separate parent-only statement, not used). R&D: 'R&D costs (expenses)' on a consolidated basis = total R&D expenditure KRW 35,021,531m less government subsidies KRW 23,389m; no development costs capitalised in 2024.
